plugin.name: PortalUse
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Tracks worn portal usage with colour output; can show destination area from PortalDex.

trigger.match: You stop using (.+) as a portal

trigger.name: scan_end
trigger.match: ^(You have \d+|There are no items|The \w+ is empty)

muclient.script:
--------------------------------------------------------- -- PortalUse 2.0 (formerly Portal Usage Tracker v8.0) ---------------------------------------------------------
local usage = {} local ignore = {} local colors = {} local data_file = "PortalUse.dat" local bag_keyword = "" local scan_active = false local show_area = false -- show destination area (from PortalValue 3.0's catalog) local RedrawIfOpen -- set by the usage window code further down
-- theme colours (RGB hex of @x099 / @x045 / @W / @x048) for our own output; -- portal NAME rendering keeps its own captured colours and is never changed. local TC = { hdr = "#875fff", val = "#00d7ff", num = "#ffffff", ok = "#00ff87" }
-- Read the portal catalog written by PortalValue 3.0 (PortalDex folded in) and -- return a map of lowercased portal name -> destination area ("Leads to"). -- Returns {} if PortalValue 3.0 isn't installed / hasn't scanned. -- Area keyword lookup from the GMCP mapper's sqlite db (read only). -- Returns room_area[uid] = keyword and name_kw[lowercased long name] = keyword, -- or two empty tables if the mapper / db / sqlite3 isn't available. local MAPPER_ID = "b6eae87ccedd84f510b74714" local function area_keywords () local room_area, name_kw = {}, {} if not IsPluginInstalled(MAPPER_ID) then return room_area, name_kw end local db_name = GetPluginVariable(MAPPER_ID, "db_name") if not db_name or db_name == "" then db_name = (WorldName() or ""):gsub("[^%w%s()_-]", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") end if db_name == "" then return room_area, name_kw end local path = GetInfo(66) .. db_name .. ".db" local fh = io.open(path, "rb") if not fh then return room_area, name_kw end fh:close() local ok_sql, sqlite3 = pcall(require, "sqlite3") if not ok_sql then return room_area, name_kw end local db = sqlite3.open(path) if not db then return room_area, name_kw end pcall(function () for row in db:nrows("SELECT uid, name FROM areas") do if row.uid and row.name then name_kw[row.name:lower()] = row.uid end end for row in db:nrows("SELECT uid, area FROM rooms") do if row.uid and row.area then room_area[tostring(row.uid)] = row.area end end end) db:close() return room_area, name_kw end
local function load_portaldex_areas () local f = io.open(GetInfo(66) .. "PortalDex_data.lua", "r") if not f then return {} end local content = f:read("*a"); f:close() local ok, data = pcall(function() return assert(loadstring(content))() end) if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.catalog) ~= "table" then return {} end local map = {} for _, e in pairs(data.catalog) do local area = (e.leads and e.leads ~= "?") and e.leads or nil if e.name and (area or e.room) then local key = e.name:lower() local cur = map[key] -- several catalog entries can share a name (plain chaos portals); -- prefer one that has a landing room over one that only has an area if (not cur) or (e.room and not cur.room) then map[key] = { area = area, room = e.room } end end end -- swap the long area name for the area keyword where the mapper knows it if next(map) ~= nil then local room_area, name_kw = area_keywords() for _, v in pairs(map) do local kw = (v.room and room_area[tostring(v.room)]) or (v.area and name_kw[v.area:lower()]) if kw then v.area = kw end end end return map end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- Utility ---------------------------------------------------------
local function clean_name (s) s = s:gsub("\27%[[0-9;]*m", "") s = s:gsub("<[^>]+>", "") s = s:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") return s end
local function rgb_to_hex (n) if not n then return "#ffffff" end local r = n % 256 local g = math.floor(n / 256) % 256 local b = math.floor(n / 65536) % 256 return string.format("#%02x%02x%02x", r, g, b) end
local function rgb_to_xterm (n) if not n then return 7 end local r = n % 256 local g = math.floor(n / 256) % 256 local b = math.floor(n / 65536) % 256 if r == g and g == b then if r < 8 then return 16 end if r > 238 then return 231 end return math.floor((r - 8) / 10) + 232 end local function to6 (v) if v < 48 then return 0 elseif v < 115 then return 1 elseif v < 155 then return 2 elseif v < 195 then return 3 elseif v < 235 then return 4 else return 5 end end return 16 + 36 * to6(r) + 6 * to6(g) + to6(b) end
local function extract_name_styles (styles, plain_name) if not styles or #styles == 0 then return nil end local full_text = "" for _, sp in ipairs(styles) do full_text = full_text .. (sp.text or "") end local s, e = full_text:find(plain_name, 1, true) if not s then return nil end local result = {} local pos = 1 for _, sp in ipairs(styles) do local sp_text = sp.text or "" local sp_end = pos + #sp_text - 1 if sp_end >= s and pos <= e then local clip_s = math.max(pos, s) local clip_e = math.min(sp_end, e) local clipped = sp_text:sub(clip_s - pos + 1, clip_e - pos + 1) if clipped ~= "" then table.insert(result, { text = clipped, fore = rgb_to_hex(sp.textcolour), xterm = rgb_to_xterm(sp.textcolour), }) end end pos = pos + #sp_text end return #result > 0 and result or nil end
-- Build an Aardwolf @xNNN colour-coded string from spans (for channel output) local function spans_to_aard (spans) if not spans then return nil end local t = {} for _, sp in ipairs(spans) do table.insert(t, string.format("@x%03d", sp.xterm) .. sp.text) end return table.concat(t) .. "@w" end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- File save / load ---------------------------------------------------------
local function hex_enc (s) return (s:gsub(".", function(c) return string.format("%02X", string.byte(c)) end)) end
local function hex_dec (s) return (s:gsub("%x%x", function(h) return string.char(tonumber(h, 16)) end)) end
local function save_data () local f = io.open(data_file, "w") if not f then ColourNote("white","red","[PortalUse] Cannot write: " .. data_file) return end f:write("USAGE\n") for portal, count in pairs(usage) do f:write(portal .. "|" .. tostring(count) .. "\n") end f:write("IGNORE\n") for portal in pairs(ignore) do f:write(portal .. "\n") end f:write("BAG\n") f:write(bag_keyword .. "\n") f:write("AREA\n") f:write((show_area and "1" or "0") .. "\n") f:write("COLORS\n") for portal, spans in pairs(colors) do local parts = {} for _, sp in ipairs(spans) do table.insert(parts, hex_enc(sp.text) .. ":" .. sp.fore .. ":" .. tostring(sp.xterm)) end f:write(hex_enc(portal) .. "|" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "\n") end f:close() if RedrawIfOpen then RedrawIfOpen() end end
local function load_data () local f = io.open(data_file, "r") if not f then return end usage = {} ignore = {} colors = {} local section = "usage" for line in f:lines() do if line == "USAGE" then section = "usage" elseif line == "IGNORE" then section = "ignore" elseif line == "BAG" then section = "bag" elseif line == "AREA" then section = "area" elseif line == "COLORS" then section = "colors" elseif section == "usage" then local name, count = line:match("^(.*)|(%d+)$") if name and count then usage[name] = tonumber(count) end elseif section == "ignore" and line ~= "" then ignore[line] = true elseif section == "bag" and line ~= "" then bag_keyword = line elseif section == "area" and line ~= "" then show_area = (line == "1") elseif section == "colors" and line ~= "" then local enc_portal, spans_str = line:match("^([^|]+)|(.+)$") if enc_portal and spans_str then local portal = hex_dec(enc_portal) local spans = {} for part in spans_str:gmatch("[^,]+") do local enc_text, fore, xterm = part:match("^([^:]+):(#%x+):(%d+)$") if enc_text and fore and xterm then table.insert(spans, { text = hex_dec(enc_text), fore = fore, xterm = tonumber(xterm) }) end end if #spans > 0 then colors[portal] = spans end end end end f:close() end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- Plugin lifecycle ---------------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginInstall () load_data() ColourNote(TC.hdr, "", "[PortalUse] ", TC.num, "", "v" .. GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 19) .. " loaded. Type ", TC.ok, "", "portalhelp", TC.num, "", " for help.") end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- Scan ---------------------------------------------------------
local expecting_header = false
function start_scan () if bag_keyword == "" then ColourNote("white","red","[PortalUse] No bag set. Use: portalsetbag <keyword>") return end scan_active = false expecting_header = true EnableTrigger("scan_start", true) EnableTrigger("scan_item", false) EnableTrigger("scan_end", false) ColourNote(TC.val,"","[PortalUse] Scanning " .. bag_keyword .. " for colours...") SendNoEcho("exa " .. bag_keyword) -- Safety timeout in case scan_end trigger never fires DoAfterSpecial(3, "CallPlugin('3fa92c7bd184e55a9c02b6da','scan_timeout','')", sendto.script) end
function OnScanStart (name, line, wildcards, styles) if not expecting_header then return end expecting_header = false EnableTrigger("scan_start", false) scan_active = true EnableTrigger("scan_item", true) EnableTrigger("scan_end", true) end
function OnScanItem (name, line, wildcards, styles) if not scan_active then return end local plain_name = clean_name(wildcards[1]) if plain_name == "" then return end if ignore[plain_name] then return end if not usage[plain_name] then usage[plain_name] = 0 end local spans = extract_name_styles(styles, plain_name) if spans then colors[plain_name] = spans end end
function OnScanEnd (name, line, wildcards, styles) scan_active = false expecting_header = false EnableTrigger("scan_start", false) EnableTrigger("scan_item", false) EnableTrigger("scan_end", false) save_data() ColourNote(TC.val,"","[PortalUse] Scan complete. (matched: [" .. line .. "])") end
function scan_timeout () if scan_active then scan_active = false expecting_header = false EnableTrigger("scan_start", false) EnableTrigger("scan_item", false) EnableTrigger("scan_end", false) save_data() ColourNote(TC.val,"","[PortalUse] Scan complete (timeout).") end end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- Trigger: worn portal usage ---------------------------------------------------------
function OnPortalEnter (name, line, wildcards, styles) local portal = clean_name(wildcards[1]) if ignore[portal] then return end usage[portal] = (usage[portal] or 0) + 1 if not colors[portal] then local spans = extract_name_styles(styles, portal) if spans then colors[portal] = spans end end save_data() end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- portaluse / portalusage ---------------------------------------------------------
-- old output-window list; now only the fallback if the window can't open local function print_usage (mode)
local list = {} for portal, count in pairs(usage) do table.insert(list, { portal = portal, count = count }) end
if mode == "alpha" then table.sort(list, function(a,b) return a.portal < b.portal end) elseif mode == "ralpha" then table.sort(list, function(a,b) return a.portal > b.portal end) elseif mode == "low" then table.sort(list, function(a,b) return a.count < b.count end) else table.sort(list, function(a,b) return a.count > b.count end) end
ColourNote(TC.hdr,"","Portal Usage (" .. mode .. ")")
local areas = show_area and load_portaldex_areas() or nil
for _, entry in ipairs(list) do if not ignore[entry.portal] then -- still honour the ignore list local spans = colors[entry.portal] if spans then for _, sp in ipairs(spans) do ColourTell(sp.fore, "", sp.text) end else ColourTell("blue","", entry.portal) end if areas then local a = areas[entry.portal:lower()] if a then if a.area then ColourTell(TC.val,"", " [" .. a.area .. "]") end if a.room then ColourTell(TC.ok, "", " (" .. a.room .. ")") end end end ColourTell(TC.hdr, "", " USES: ") ColourTell(TC.num, "", tostring(entry.count)) Note("") end end Note("") Note("") end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- Usage window (portaluse) -- Same chrome as PupPaths / Keycheck / MarketWatch: themed_miniwindows' -- ThemedTextWindow with the package theme, our palette on the text only. -- Link text is Lua run in this plugin (text_rect.lua browseUrl -> -- loadstring), so the PU_* click handlers are global. ---------------------------------------------------------
local gHaveWin = pcall(require, "themed_miniwindows")
local WIN_ID = "PortalUse_list" local WIN_FONT = "Consolas" local WIN_FONT_SIZE = 13 local SORT_MODES = { "high", "low", "alpha", "ralpha" }
local gWin = nil local win_mode = "high" local show_ignored = false local area_cache = nil -- area map for the window; nil = rebuild on next draw
local gColCache = {} local function col (hex) if not gColCache[hex] then gColCache[hex] = ColourNameToRGB(hex) end return gColCache[hex] end
-- One line of style runs plus its hyperlinks. Link positions count the -- VISIBLE text only, which is what TextRect indexes against. local function winLine (segs) local styles, links, pos = {}, {}, 1 for _, sg in ipairs(segs) do if sg.text ~= "" then styles[#styles + 1] = { text = sg.text, textcolour = col(sg.colour or TC.num) } if sg.code then links[#links + 1] = { start = pos, stop = pos + #sg.text - 1, text = sg.code, label = sg.tip } end pos = pos + #sg.text end end return styles, links end
-- Never reuse an object the library no longer knows about (a zombie window -- has live hotspots and no window_map entry). local function ensureWin () if not gHaveWin then return false end if gWin and not (ThemedWindowClass and ThemedWindowClass.window_map and ThemedWindowClass.window_map[WIN_ID]) then gWin = nil pcall(WindowDelete, WIN_ID) end if not gWin then local ok, w = pcall(ThemedTextWindow, WIN_ID, 0, 0, -- first-run position; after that it stays where dragged 700, 400, -- default size; fit_contents sizes it to the text "Portal Usage", "center", -- title alignment true, -- is_temporary: gives the title-bar close button false, -- resizeable true, -- text_scrollable: the list is taller than the cap false, -- text_selectable false, -- text_copyable false, -- url_hyperlinks: ours are explicit false, -- autowrap: rows are laid out in columns WIN_FONT, WIN_FONT_SIZE, -- title font WIN_FONT, WIN_FONT_SIZE, -- text font 1000, -- max lines (340+ portals already) nil, -- padding true, -- defer showing until drawn false, nil, "Close") if not ok or not w then gHaveWin = false return false end gWin = w -- Bold body text, as in Keycheck / PupPaths: redefine the TextRect's -- normal font as bold so widths and link hotspots are measured with it. pcall(function() local tr = gWin.textrect WindowFont(tr.window, tr.font, WIN_FONT, WIN_FONT_SIZE, true, false, false, false, 0) tr.font_height = WindowFontInfo(tr.window, tr.font, 1) tr:setLineSpacing(tr.line_spacing) end) local prior = gWin.do_on_delete gWin.do_on_delete = function(self) if prior then prior(self) end if gWin == self then gWin = nil end end end return true end
local function sort_list (list, mode) local function byname (a, b) return a.portal < b.portal end if mode == "alpha" then table.sort(list, byname) elseif mode == "ralpha" then table.sort(list, function(a,b) return a.portal > b.portal end) elseif mode == "low" then table.sort(list, function(a,b) if a.count ~= b.count then return a.count < b.count end return byname(a, b) end) else table.sort(list, function(a,b) if a.count ~= b.count then return a.count > b.count end return byname(a, b) end) end return list end
-- the portal name in its captured colours local function name_segs (portal) local segs, len = {}, 0 local spans = colors[portal] if spans then for _, sp in ipairs(spans) do segs[#segs + 1] = { text = sp.text, colour = sp.fore } len = len + #sp.text end end if len == 0 then segs = { { text = portal, colour = "blue" } } end return segs end
local function row_segs (entry, button, countW, areas) local ref = string.format("%q", entry.portal) local segs = { { text = " " } } if button == "ignore" then segs[#segs + 1] = { text = "[ignore]", colour = TC.val, code = "PU_Ignore(" .. ref .. ")", tip = "Ignore " .. entry.portal .. " (hide it and stop counting it)" } segs[#segs + 1] = { text = " " } -- pad to [restore]'s width, outside the link else segs[#segs + 1] = { text = "[restore]", colour = TC.ok, code = "PU_Restore(" .. ref .. ")", tip = "Stop ignoring " .. entry.portal } end local cnt = tostring(entry.count) segs[#segs + 1] = { text = string.rep(" ", 2 + countW - #cnt) } segs[#segs + 1] = { text = cnt, colour = TC.num } segs[#segs + 1] = { text = " " } for _, sg in ipairs(name_segs(entry.portal)) do segs[#segs + 1] = sg end if areas then local a = areas[entry.portal:lower()] if a then if a.area then segs[#segs + 1] = { text = " [" .. a.area .. "]", colour = TC.val } end if a.room then segs[#segs + 1] = { text = " (" .. a.room .. ")", colour = TC.ok } end end end return segs end
-- Draw the window. keep_scroll: a redraw of a window that is already up -- stays where you were reading instead of jumping back to the top. local function ShowWindow (keep_scroll) local keep = nil if keep_scroll and gWin and gWin.textrect then keep = tonumber(gWin.textrect.display_start_line) end if not ensureWin() then print_usage(win_mode) return end gWin:clear(false)
local areas = nil if show_area then if not area_cache then area_cache = load_portaldex_areas() end areas = area_cache end
local list, total = {}, 0 for portal, count in pairs(usage) do -- an empty name can sit in old data files; it has nothing to show or click if not ignore[portal] and portal ~= "" then list[#list + 1] = { portal = portal, count = count } total = total + count end end sort_list(list, win_mode)
local ign = {} for portal in pairs(ignore) do ign[#ign + 1] = { portal = portal, count = usage[portal] or 0 } end sort_list(ign, "alpha")
-- Button / status line local top = { { text = " Sort: ", colour = TC.val } } for _, m in ipairs(SORT_MODES) do local cur = (m == win_mode) top[#top + 1] = { text = cur and ("[" .. m .. "]") or m, colour = cur and TC.ok or TC.hdr, code = "PU_Sort(" .. string.format("%q", m) .. ")", tip = "Sort by " .. m } top[#top + 1] = { text = " " } end top[#top + 1] = { text = " Area: ", colour = TC.val } top[#top + 1] = { text = show_area and "ON" or "OFF", colour = show_area and TC.ok or TC.hdr, code = "PU_ToggleArea()", tip = "Turn the destination area display " .. (show_area and "off" or "on") } top[#top + 1] = { text = " " } top[#top + 1] = show_ignored and { text = "[ Hide ignored ]", colour = TC.ok, code = "PU_ToggleIgnored()", tip = "Hide the ignored portals" } or { text = "[ Show ignored (" .. #ign .. ") ]", colour = TC.ok, code = "PU_ToggleIgnored()", tip = "List the ignored portals, with [restore] buttons" } local st, lk = winLine(top) gWin:add_text(st, false, lk) gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " " .. #list .. " portals, " .. total .. " uses", colour = TC.val }, }, false, {}) gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " " } }, false, {})
local countW = 4 for _, e in ipairs(list) do if #tostring(e.count) > countW then countW = #tostring(e.count) end end for _, e in ipairs(ign) do if #tostring(e.count) > countW then countW = #tostring(e.count) end end
if #list == 0 then gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " No portal uses yet. Wear a portal and use it, or run ", colour = TC.num }, { text = "portalscan", colour = TC.ok }, { text = ".", colour = TC.num }, }, false, {}) else -- " [ignore] " is 10 wide, then 2 + countW for the right-aligned count gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = string.rep(" ", 12 + countW - 4) .. "Uses Portal", colour = TC.hdr }, }, false, {}) for _, e in ipairs(list) do st, lk = winLine(row_segs(e, "ignore", countW, areas)) gWin:add_text(st, false, lk) end end
if show_ignored then gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " " } }, false, {}) gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " Ignored portals:", colour = TC.hdr } }, false, {}) if #ign == 0 then gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " (none)", colour = TC.num } }, false, {}) else for _, e in ipairs(ign) do st, lk = winLine(row_segs(e, "restore", countW, areas)) gWin:add_text(st, false, lk) end end end
gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " " } }, false, {}) gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " [ignore]", colour = TC.val }, { text = " hides a portal and stops counting it. ", colour = TC.num }, { text = "[restore]", colour = TC.ok }, { text = " brings it back.", colour = TC.num }, }, false, {}) gWin:add_text(winLine { { text = " portalusetop <channel>", colour = TC.ok }, { text = " sends the top 5 to a channel. ", colour = TC.num }, { text = "portalhelp", colour = TC.ok }, { text = " for all commands.", colour = TC.num }, }, false, {})
-- 500px tall at most; the rest scrolls (wheel or scrollbar). pcall(function() gWin:fit_contents(2000, 500) end) -- Scroll AFTER fitting: add_text follows the newest line like a console, -- and rows above the viewport get no hotspot when drawn. pcall(function() gWin:set_scroll(keep or 1) end) gWin:draw() gWin:show() -- The layout's invisible drag bar (z 154) eats clicks on windows under it. pcall(WindowSetZOrder, WIN_ID, 99999) pcall(Repaint) end
-- Redraw the window if it is up, keeping the scroll. -- Safe from inside a link click: no WindowDelete happens here. RedrawIfOpen = function () if gWin then ShowWindow(true) end end
function PU_Ignore (portal) if type(portal) ~= "string" then return end ignore[portal] = true save_data() -- redraws end
function PU_Restore (portal) if type(portal) ~= "string" then return end ignore[portal] = nil save_data() -- redraws end
function PU_Sort (mode) win_mode = mode or "high" RedrawIfOpen() end
function PU_ToggleArea () show_area = not show_area area_cache = nil save_data() -- redraws, which rebuilds area_cache if show_area and area_cache and next(area_cache) == nil then ColourNote("white","red","[PortalUse] No portal catalog found - the area display needs PortalValue 3.3 or higher, with a 'portaldex scan' done.") end end
function PU_ToggleIgnored () show_ignored = not show_ignored RedrawIfOpen() end
function OnPortalUsage (name, line, wildcards) local mode = string.match(line, "^%S+%s+(%S+)$") mode = mode and string.lower(mode) or "high" local known = false for _, m in ipairs(SORT_MODES) do if m == mode then known = true end end win_mode = known and mode or "high" area_cache = nil -- typed command: re-read the catalog ShowWindow(false) end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- portalusetop ---------------------------------------------------------
function OnPortalUseTop (name, line, wildcards) local channel = line:match("^portalusetop%s+(%S+)$") if not channel or channel == "" then ColourNote("white","red","Usage: portalusetop <channel>") return end
local list = {} for portal, count in pairs(usage) do if not ignore[portal] then -- still honour the ignore list table.insert(list, { portal = portal, count = count }) end end table.sort(list, function(a,b) return a.count > b.count end)
local areas = show_area and load_portaldex_areas() or nil
local parts = {} for i = 1, math.min(5, #list) do local entry = list[i] local aard = spans_to_aard(colors[entry.portal]) or entry.portal local areatag = "" if areas then local a = areas[entry.portal:lower()] if a then local inner = a.area or "" if a.room then inner = (inner ~= "" and (inner .. " ") or "") .. a.room end if inner ~= "" then areatag = "@x045 [" .. inner .. "]@w" end end end parts[i] = aard .. areatag .. "@w(" .. entry.count .. ")" end
local msg = "Top portals: " .. table.concat(parts, "@w | ") Send(channel .. " " .. msg) end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- portalignore ---------------------------------------------------------
function OnPortalIgnore (name, line, wildcards) local arg = wildcards[1] if not arg or arg == "" then ColourNote("white","red","Usage: portalignore <portal> | portalignore list") return end if string.lower(arg) == "list" then ColourNote(TC.hdr,"","Ignored portals:") local any = false for portal in pairs(ignore) do any = true ColourTell("yellow","",portal) Note("") end if not any then ColourNote(TC.num,"","(none)") end return end local portal = clean_name(arg) if ignore[portal] then ignore[portal] = nil ColourNote("white","red","Removed from ignore list: " .. portal) else ignore[portal] = true ColourNote(TC.ok,"","Added to ignore list: " .. portal) end save_data() end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- portalreset ---------------------------------------------------------
function OnPortalReset (name, line, wildcards) local arg = string.match(line, "^portalreset%s+(.*)$") if not arg or arg == "" then ColourNote("white","red","Usage: portalreset all | portalreset <portal>") return end if string.lower(arg) == "all" then usage = {} colors = {} ColourNote(TC.hdr,"","All portal usage reset.") save_data() return end local portal = clean_name(arg) if usage[portal] then usage[portal] = nil colors[portal] = nil ColourNote(TC.ok,"","Reset usage for: " .. portal) else ColourNote("white","red","No usage found for: " .. portal) end save_data() end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- portalscan / portalsetbag ---------------------------------------------------------
function OnPortalScan (name, line, wildcards) start_scan() end
function OnPortalSetBag (name, line, wildcards) local arg = wildcards[1] and wildcards[1]:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if arg == "" then if bag_keyword == "" then ColourNote(TC.val,"","[PortalUse] No bag keyword set. Use: portalsetbag <keyword>") else ColourNote(TC.val,"","[PortalUse] Current bag keyword: " .. bag_keyword) end return end bag_keyword = arg ColourNote(TC.val,"","[PortalUse] Bag keyword set to: " .. bag_keyword) save_data() end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- portalclean ---------------------------------------------------------
function OnPortalClean (name, line, wildcards) local removed = 0 for portal, count in pairs(usage) do if count == 0 then usage[portal] = nil colors[portal] = nil removed = removed + 1 end end save_data() ColourNote(TC.val,"","[PortalUse] Removed " .. removed .. " portal(s) with 0 uses.") end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- portalarea ---------------------------------------------------------
function OnPortalArea (name, line, wildcards) local arg = (line:match("^portalarea%s+(%S+)") or ""):lower() if arg == "on" then show_area = true elseif arg == "off" then show_area = false elseif arg == "" then show_area = not show_area else ColourNote("white","red","Usage: portalarea on|off"); return end area_cache = nil save_data() ColourNote(TC.val,"","[PortalUse] Destination area + landing room display is " .. (show_area and "ON" or "OFF") .. ".") if show_area and next(load_portaldex_areas()) == nil then ColourNote("white","red"," (No catalog found - this needs PortalValue 3.3 or higher, with a 'portaldex scan' done.)") end end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- portalhelp ---------------------------------------------------------
function OnPortalHelp () ColourNote(TC.hdr,"","PortalUse 2.3") ColourNote(TC.val,"","Commands:") ColourNote(TC.val,""," portaluse [mode] -- Open the usage window (sort: high, low, alpha, ralpha)") ColourNote(TC.num, ""," click [ignore] on a row to ignore a portal; [ Show ignored ] to restore") ColourNote(TC.val,""," portalusetop <channel> -- Send top 5 portals to a channel") ColourNote(TC.val,""," portalscan -- Refresh colours, add untracked portals with 0 uses") ColourNote(TC.val,""," portalsetbag <keyword> -- Set the bag keyword for portalscan") ColourNote(TC.val,""," portalarea on|off -- Show destination area + landing room per portal") ColourNote(TC.num, ""," requires PortalValue 3.3 or higher (uses its portal catalog)") ColourNote(TC.num, ""," run 'portaldex rooms' there if room numbers are missing") ColourNote(TC.val,""," portalignore <portal> -- Toggle ignoring a portal") ColourNote(TC.val,""," portalignore list -- Show ignored portals") ColourNote(TC.val,""," portalclean -- Remove all portals with 0 uses") ColourNote(TC.val,""," portalreset all -- Reset all usage") ColourNote(TC.val,""," portalreset <portal> -- Reset one portal") ColourNote(TC.val,""," portalhelp -- Show this help") end
